title: さくら色の最終列車と、琥珀色の記憶を運ぶ双子
author: ポム・ド・テール

en.title: The Cherry-Blossom Last Train and the Twins Carrying Amber Memories
en.premise: At a station shrouded in pink mist, twins sharing a single broken pocket watch arrive. They long to reclaim the 'time' that has stood still, but Luna, a guide cat, teaches them that the broken watch is actually the precious proof of the bond that connects them. Through the slow-moving days at the station, this is a story of how the twins transform their despair into warm, cherished memories.

zh.title: 樱花色的末班车与承载琥珀色记忆的双胞胎
zh.premise: 在弥漫着粉色雾气的车站，一对共同拥有一只破损怀表的双胞胎抵达了这里。他们渴望找回那停滞的“时间”，但向导猫露娜却告诉他们，这只破碎的怀表正是连接两人珍贵羁绊的证明。通过在车站里缓缓流逝的时光，这是一个关于双胞胎将绝望转化为温暖回忆的故事。
